description: Open an ncrypted link and write its value straight into a Vercel project environment variable (type sensitive), so the value never appears in this conversation. Uses the user's `vercel login` session or VERCEL_TOKEN. Checks Vercel access before consuming the link. Prefer this over reading a secret and running `vercel env add`.

cwd.description: Project directory containing .vercel/project.json. Default: the server's working directory.

project.description: Vercel project name or id. Default: the project linked in cwd's .vercel/project.json.

team.description: Vercel team id (team_...) or slug. Default: the linked project's team.

name: ncrypted_to_vercel_env
title: Save one-time secret to a Vercel env var
